description: This file defines the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator enum, which contains logic for validating and resolving system commands related to executing shell commands, including parsing wrappers, environment manipulations, and inline commands in a Swift-based codebase.

classes.name: ResolvedCommand
classes.description: A structure representing a resolved command with its display string and optionally an evaluation raw command.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: An enum representing either a successful resolution with a ResolvedCommand or a failure with an error message.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the command array and optional raw command into a ValidationResult, primarily used to validate and format the command for execution.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Determines and returns the allowable raw command string for evaluation, based on command structure and wrappers.
